tenant_scoped_api.evidence: apps/api controllers, RBAC tests, and PostgreSQL integration smoke test

local_demo_authentication.evidence: explicit DEMO_AUTH_ENABLED=true and demo authentication tests

durable_postgresql_scan_queue.evidence: atomic claims, bounded retries, stale-lock recovery, and integration smoke test

github_app_repository_onboarding.reason: signed installation and webhook lifecycle are not implemented

distributed_rate_limiting.reason: the current limiter is bounded in-memory and per API instance

dependency_vulnerability_intelligence.reason: SBOM output is inventory only; no CVE provider is configured

limitations: The static dashboard contains a deterministic demo console and is not proof of a live authenticated API deployment.
No production OIDC provider has been configured in the current environment.
No Neon connection strings have been injected into the deployment.
No Azure Container Apps API or scheduled worker resource has been created.
Security receipts are SHA-256 integrity hashes, not digital signatures or non-repudiation.
Secret scanning uses high-confidence patterns and does not provide entropy analysis.
The PostgreSQL polling queue is not a benchmarked high-throughput distributed queue.
